momentum.label: Momentum (UMD)
momentum.blurb: AQR's UMD: the cumulative return over months t-12 to t-2, skipping the most recent month. Long the winners, short the losers.
momentum.literature: Jegadeesh & Titman (1993); Asness, Moskowitz & Pedersen (2013) "Value and Momentum Everywhere"; AQR data library UMD

value.label: Value (HML Devil)
value.blurb: Book-to-price with the most recent book value and the current price, Asness & Frazzini's "Devil in HML's details". Long cheap, short expensive.
value.literature: Asness & Frazzini (2013); AQR data library HML Devil

value_composite.label: Value (composite)
value_composite.blurb: AQR's multi-measure value: standardised log book-to-price, log sales-to-price, cash-flow-to-price and earnings-to-price averaged, all on current prices.
value_composite.literature: Asness, Frazzini, Israel & Moskowitz (2015) "Fact, Fiction and Value Investing"

quality.label: Quality (QMJ)
quality.blurb: Quality Minus Junk: profitability (gross profits, ROE, ROA, cash flow over assets, gross margin, low accruals), growth (their five-year change) and safety (low beta, low leverage, low O-score, high Z-score, stable earnings), each a z-score of ranks, summed and standardised.
quality.literature: Asness, Frazzini & Pedersen (2019) "Quality Minus Junk"; AQR data library QMJ

bab.label: Betting against beta
bab.blurb: Frazzini & Pedersen: names ranked by a shrunk beta (one-year volatility ratio times the five-year correlation of three-day returns, 0.6 beta + 0.4); low-beta names long, levered to beta one, high-beta names short, de-levered to beta one.
bab.literature: Frazzini & Pedersen (2014) "Betting Against Beta"; AQR data library BAB

size.label: Size (SMB)
size.blurb: Small minus big: long the small half of the universe by market value, short the big half, value-weighted. Within the liquid, point-in-time universe the ADV floor leaves.
size.literature: Fama & French (1993) SMB; Asness, Frazzini, Israel, Moskowitz & Pedersen (2018) "Size Matters, If You Control Your Junk"

investment.label: Investment (CMA)
investment.blurb: Conservative minus aggressive: minus one-year growth in total assets. Firms that grow their balance sheet fastest earn less.

reversal.label: Short-term reversal (STR)
reversal.blurb: Minus the past month's return. Liquidity provision: last month's losers bounce. The fastest factor and the most cost-sensitive.

construction: universe, point in time: top N by market value as it stood each month end (delisted names included), one share class per issuer; daily guards: 252 days of history, ADV floor in USD, market-value floor in USD, price floor in quote units, traded on 90% of the last 63 sessions
return-based factors: each name's daily return capped at 5 trailing sigma before the indicator; characteristic factors winsorised at 1% per date (QMJ components are z-scores of ranks)

AQR construction: whole market ranked, 2x3 sort on size (big = names covering 90% of value) x factor (30/70), value-weighted legs, small and big spreads averaged; SMB = small half minus big half; BAB = rank-weighted, beta-neutral, levered legs

sector-neutral: ranked and balanced within each sector at equal weight (thin sectors pooled per date); plain: whole market at equal weight, net sector exposure capped at 10% of gross; inverse-vol: names sized by 1/vol inside each leg, legs re-balanced
every book: 5% per-name cap redistributed within the leg; monthly re-strike with 5-21 day smoothing
caveats: prices: EODHD closes are repaired at build time (sentinels, one-day spikes, adjusted-only jumps, scale breaks beyond +100%/-75% in a day); a genuine move beyond those bounds is zeroed with the errors
universe: the liquid top N by value, not the whole market, so the AQR comparison is on a narrower cross-section
fundamentals: filing dates are real only in the US; elsewhere a 60-90 day lag convention
quality: the growth component needs five years of statements
publication lag: a per-market convention (60-90 days) until the point-in-time archive has history
borrow: a flat per-market rate; eligible lists are not public feeds
sector map: each name's GICS sector as EODHD states it today (the old Yahoo profile where EODHD has none), applied to all history
tier 3 markets: the short leg cannot be traded; the book is a measurement
